title: Chai Apple Pie
description: Try this twist on tradition with chai-spiced apple pie, featuring the cozy warmth of chai spices that will fill your home with aromas of the holidays.
ingredients: 2 pinches ground black pepper, or more to taste

steps.text: Heat apple juice in the microwave in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals until very warm, but not boiling. Add chai tea bags, cover, and let steep for 10 minutes. Discard tea bags.
Meanwhile, peel, seed, and chop apples; toss them in a bowl with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Combine cinnamon, ginger, cloves, cardamom, and black pepper in a small bowl.

Combine apples, apple juice-chai tea mixture, cinnamon-spice mixture, brown sugar, butter, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt in a large pot. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until apples soften, about 30 minutes.

Transfer 1/4 cup of apple liquid from the pot to a small bowl. Add cornstarch and whisk until completely dissolved. Stir mixture back into the pot. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring often, until mixture thickens, about 5 minutes. Pour filling into a bowl and set aside to cool, about 1 hour.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).

Pour filling into one pie crust. Press remaining pie crust over apple filling; flute the edges to seal or use a fork dipped in egg to press them down. Brush remaining egg on top, then cut several slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape. Cover edges of pie with aluminum foil to avoid burning.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Gently remove foil and continue to bake until golden and bubbly, about 15 minutes more. Allow to cool until pie is warm, but not hot, before serving.
